name: Generating a cover letter with AI produces letter content
description: A logged-in user navigates specifically to the cover letter creation page at /cover-letter/new, fills in job details, clicks the AI generate button, waits for generation, and verifies actual generated paragraph text appears in the letter body - not JSON, not a placeholder, not empty - and that the letter subsequently appears in Letter History.

planSteps.description: Enter testsprite@gmail.com in the email field
Click the Write Letter button on the dashboard
Verify the page now shows a cover letter creation form with company name and position input fields
Fill in the company name field with TestCorp
Fill in the position field with Software Engineer
Click the button that triggers AI letter generation
Wait for the AI generation process to finish loading
Verify a multi-sentence paragraph of natural language cover letter text is displayed in the letter content area, and confirm it does not contain curly braces, JSON key-value syntax, or array brackets
Navigate to the Letter History page
Verify the newly generated letter for TestCorp appears as an entry in the letter history list
